items.t: Automatic transmission slipping or failing
items.job: Replace automatic transmission with remanufactured unit
items.note: CarComplaints lists about $1,500 as a typical owner-reported cost; a used transmission costs less.

items.t: Shudder or harsh shift from first to second gear
items.job: Diagnose; replace second clutch pack or recondition valve body
items.note: A fluid change and diagnosis come first; internal repairs need the transmission opened.

items.t: ABS and traction lights on, or brakes applying by themselves
items.job: Diagnose ABS; replace wheel speed sensor/hub or brake control module
items.note: A hub with built-in sensor is the cheaper end; the electronic brake control module is the expensive end.

items.t: Brake pedal pulsation from uneven front rotors
items.job: Replace front brake pads and rotors

items.t: Power sliding door won't close, reopens or stops working
items.job: Adjust door; replace rollers, cable, motor or door module
items.note: Adjustment and lubrication alone fix some doors.

items.t: Sliding door opening while the van is moving
items.job: Diagnose and repair sliding door latch or sensor

items.t: Fuel gauge reads wrong or low fuel light stays on
items.job: Replace fuel level sender or fuel pump module

items.t: No-start or stalling from a wet connector under the driver's seat
items.job: Clean, dry and repair corroded connector under driver's seat

items.t: Intermittent no-crank or dead battery
items.job: Test battery and charging; find parasitic drain or starter circuit fault
items.note: Parts cost depends on whether a battery, relay or starter is needed.

items.t: Check engine light from a failed EGR valve
items.job: Replace EGR valve and reflash engine computer

items.t: Whistle when accelerating from the PCV tube
items.job: Replace PCV tube

items.t: Engine computer chip defect (emissions recall)
items.job: Replace engine computer (recall)

items.t: Coolant leak from crossover pipe gaskets
items.job: Replace coolant crossover pipe gaskets and refill coolant
items.note: If the leak has reached the intake manifold gaskets, labor rises.

items.t: Oil leak at the oil pan or front crankshaft seal
items.job: Replace oil pan gasket or front crankshaft seal

items.t: Groaning, clunk or knock when turning
items.job: Flush power steering fluid or replace intermediate shaft/tie rods
items.note: A failing power steering pump costs more; RepairPal estimates about $409–$478 to replace it.

items.t: Power steering high-pressure hose leak
items.job: Replace power steering high-pressure hose

items.t: Front wheel bearing hum or wheel speed sensor fault
items.job: Replace front wheel hub and bearing assembly

items.t: Rear shocks leak or wear out
items.job: Replace rear shocks (pair)
items.note: Vans with rear air-leveling shocks cost more.

items.t: Rear wiper stops working
items.job: Replace rear wiper motor

items.t: OnStar loses power
items.job: Replace OnStar communication interface module

items.t: Horn hard to sound
items.job: Install softer horn pad springs

items.t: Check engine light from a loose or worn gas cap
items.job: Replace gas cap

items.t: Parking brake may not fully release (recall)
items.job: Inspect parking brake; replace rear calipers if needed (recall)

items.t: Second-row seat latch can release in a side crash (recall)
items.job: Install protective cap on seat latch release (recall)

items.t: Tire and loading label shows wrong capacity (recall)
items.job: Replace tire and loading label (recall)

items.t: Some aftermarket replacement steering knuckles can break (recall)
items.job: Replace recalled aftermarket steering knuckle (Dorman recall)
items.note: Dorman replaces the part and reimburses labor.
